milestone.name: Persistent Context Protocol adoption
milestone.summary: Persistent Context Protocol, ADR-007/008/009, protected-document checks, branch-safe handoff, Hark procurement context and recovery tests are integrated on main at f2e511a; the approved PR10 bench foundation is a separate workstream recorded in the combined integration history.
milestone.next_action: Maintain the generated Brief through source/Brief commits; further governance changes require the documented owner-review and decision-change process. No hardware, purchase or capability promotion.

unresolved_questions.question: Which central-command compute baseline should be evaluated first: a workstation/server GPU or a Jetson AGX Thor-class system?
unresolved_questions.note: No purchase or deployment is implied; define workload, power, cooling, network and support gates first.

unresolved_questions.question: What are the headset tether/wireless, power, thermal, optics and local-safety envelopes for the first AR interface?
unresolved_questions.note: The headset is not required to host all AI, but local safety and latency requirements must be explicit.

unresolved_questions.question: Which distributed-node safety, timing and communications requirements must survive central-link loss?
unresolved_questions.note: Local safety cannot depend on central availability; AIR/GROUND/ORBIT remain roadmap.

unresolved_questions.question: Which Hark candidate classes have enough interface, calibration, support and compatibility evidence for a procurement review?
unresolved_questions.note: Use docs/procurement/HARK_CONTEXT.md; no SKU, quote or datasheet is a receipt or capability.

unresolved_questions.question: Which semantic contradictions and owner-intent decisions require independent review because automation cannot detect them?
unresolved_questions.note: Hash and reference checks are not semantic proofs; see docs/context/AUTOMATION_LIMITS.md.
